entries.title: The coin is struck
entries.text: PROVADIA launches on pump.fun — a fair launch, no presale, no team allocation. Contract: 9UE6NStA9pRZ5xagrK1FNy3vybmQVL2VaKB7BNpvpump. Supply 1,000,000,000, fixed.

entries.title: The founder's buy, in the open
entries.text: The founder buys 0.1 SOL of his own coin — about 0.35% of supply — disclosed in the launch receipts before any story was told.

entries.title: The Golden Wall Covenant is signed
entries.text: 20% of creator fees buy physical 1g gold bars into a named third-party vault, forever. The counter opens at 0 / 47. The Wall belongs to no one.

entries.title: The town gets its name in the world
entries.text: provadiacoin.com is registered and the town site stands live at its own address.

entries.title: The town is rebuilt as one world
entries.text: Four engines and the Streets are fused into one body on provadiacoin.com — one DNA, front to back.

entries.title: The coin takes its filing
entries.text: The town files its coin, in the same words on its Coin, Ecosystem and About pages and here in its book. Sector: Ecosystem & Services. Category: Community Currency / Ecosystem Token. Bitcoin is energy. PROVADIA is salt — the original currency — now working as the money of a service town. In-ecosystem only: pay for products and services · the 20% direct-PROVADIA payment discount · Bricklayer registry standing · the vote on the Golden Wall's fate. Not a gas/platform coin, not gold-backed, no yield, no rights.

entries.title: The Wall takes its seal
entries.text: The Golden Wall's ledger (data/golden-wall.json) is sealed with a SHA-256 digest of its own fields — 86011a778d4dd33ca9b031e8329a1c223e2ee244d11b98a86d2cb5c4f01d99c8 — and from tonight the Wall's pages recompute that seal before rendering any figure, hold it against the value pinned in the Wall's script and anchored here, and render nothing when the seal does not hold. The ledger tonight stands as it has since the Wall was raised: 0 grams · 0 of 47 bricks · the receipt locked, awaiting Brick #1.
